## touch-browser v0.7.1

Patch release focused on local-user release alignment and real-world usability hardening after the v0.7.0 release.

### Fixed

- `search-open-top` now reports failed candidates separately instead of failing the whole command when one selected result times out or cannot be opened.
- `update --check` now includes `runtimeVersion`, `installedVersion`, `latestVersion`, `versionAlignment`, and `nextCommand` so local standalone and managed install states are easier to understand.
- Interactive action rejections now explain that `--allow-domain` is required and show a concrete re-open command shape before retrying high-risk actions.

### Verified

- Added coverage for mixed successful and failed `search-open-top` candidates.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nangman-infra/touch-browser/compare/v0.7.0...v0.7.1
